translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: Romanos
book.title: Romagi Gwenadgan-Bukmaladse Pablo Garda Narmaksad Romanos

content: Gwenadgan, napiraa an-gwagegi an ibmar-bina-sogedi, degine, an Bab Dummadse Israel-dulemarga an goledi, bitigi wemar abonolesmalana-gadinye an binsaed.
Ar an nue wisid, ar an nue bemarga sogmalad, we-Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-bina nue-sogmalad, degite, bina-sogedi we ibmar-nue-wisidba bina sogsurmalad.

Ar Israel-dulemar wichurmalad, Bab Dummad iskussuliyob dulemar-imaked, a-ulale, Israel-dulemar na e-ibmar-imakedba na iskussuliyob-gued na amididimarsunnad, degisoggu, Bab Dummad ibmar-inikii-imakedba dasurmarsunnad.
Ar Moisés-igar-mesisad, we Cristose bergumaid, adi bela dulemar-Cristogi-bensurmalad Bab Dummad iskussuliyob amar-dakegar.
Ar dulemarga bela be sogele, “Jesús, Bab Dummadye,” degine, be-gwagegi be bensulile, Bab Dummad we-Jesús burgwarmalad-abargi gannar odulosad, be abonolegodo.
Ar gwagegi be Jesúsgi bensuli guer-gebed, iskussuliyob be daklegegar. Be-abonolegegardi gayagi be soger-gebed, Jesús, Bab Dummadye.
Ar Judio, degi, Judiosurmalad Bab Dummad amar akar-akar daksulid, emarbi daked. Ar Bab Dummad na ebi wargwenna bela dulemar-e-dummadga maid, bela unnitiba dulemar-ese-goledga ibmar-imakmaid.

¿Ar Jesucristogi amba benmalar, degite, igi ese gormalosunna? ¿Ar degite, igi Jesucristogi bensuli gumalosunna, ar itodisurmalar, doa Jesucristo? ¿Degite, igi itomalosunna doa Jesucristo, ar dule ega Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi sunmaksulir?
¿Ar degite, igi Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nuedgi dule ega sunmakosunna, ar dule ese barmiledsulir? Suli, ega sunmakosuli. Ar weyob Bab-Dummad-Gardagi narmakar naid:

content.text: sogdanimalad, Bab Dummad dulemar-ebo igar nudakye.

content: Ar degite, bela Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba-nued-sogedba imaksasurmalad. Ar Isaías soged:
Degisoggu, ar dule e-uayagwar itoger-gebed, geb agi Jesucristogi bensuli-gunonikoed. We itogedi, Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itoger-gebed.
Ar an egismosundo: ¿Wede Israel-dulemar Bab-Dummad-gaya-burba itossurmarsi? Itosmala. Ar Bab-Dummad-Garda soged:

content.text: ar sukun gwen bessuli e-gaya-burba barmilesye.

content: Degine, an egisbarsundo: ¿Wede, Israel-dulemarde we gaya-burba wisgussurmarsi? Wisgusmala. Ar Moisés-insa gebe soged:

content.text: an na oyononikid, an doa-dule gue.”
deyob an osedosad ese gornai, anse dagmalagar.
